parsed.why: Administrative gender recognition, funded care, hate-crime penalties, supportive heads of state, no visitor-facing restrictions documented; only deduction is a documented 2019 case of a trans woman held in a men's facility with custodial inaction.

Never criminalised same-sex conduct, no documented targeting of trans people, some third-gender cultural visibility; but tolerance is conditional on not being conspicuous, LGBT webpages blocked, no protections, thin data and social taboo.

Enforced sodomy law, fact-checked de facto criminalisation of being transgender, no recognition or care, police raids with mass arrests, vigilante killings with police complicity, no recourse, openly hostile society.

Courts repeatedly rule for trans people (restroom advice struck down, no surgery mandate), capital LGBTQ districts positive; deductions for health-ministry refusal of hospitalisation guidelines, violent religious protests with police inaction, no anti-discrimination law.

Strong formal framework (self-ID, X markers, care, marriage) with courts striking down decrees, but documented deterioration: agency abolished, record hate crimes, activists describing escalating vulnerability and government hostility toward the community.
